_schema.description: Skill definitions read by SkillDatabase. Intentionally empty: production skills are game-design content and are not invented here. Automated tests use their own fixtures via SkillDatabase.load_from_array().

entry.name: String
entry.class_id: String - matches pathfinder_classes.json; empty means any class
entry.jp_cost: int >= 0 - Job Points spent to unlock
entry.sp_cost: int >= 0 - active only, forced to 0 for passive
entry.cooldown: float >= 0 seconds - active only, forced to 0 for passive
